subject: Model intake: request to pin Comet-13b-lite (v1.2.0) and lifecycle matrix for Q4 pilot
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lang <sarah@acmehealth.io>
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Model intake: request to pin Comet-13b-lite (v1.2.0) and lifecycle matrix for Q4 pilot

Hi team,

We have a committed Q4 pilot with Acme Health that will start trials mid-September. Acme wants the lighter Comet-13b variant for on-prem inference (privacy + cost). Before we open the pilot, product asks us to pin the current serving version (Comet-13b-lite v1.2.0) to prevent unintended rollforwards while we validate behavior and telemetry for their workload.

Why this is an ask now:
- Quick note: recent upstream changes (tokenizer mapping tweak in v1.2.1) produce subtle scoring shifts on clinical prompts we care about. Acme flagged a few prompt examples for which answers changed tone.
- Runtime: the v1.2.0 memory profile is borderline on our 8GB inference pods at seq_len=2048; we observed a few OOMs during load tests.
- Product wants a lifecycle matrix that lists ownership, validation gates, and a rollback plan for the pin window. I attached an initial matrix (comet13b_lifecycle_matrix_v1.xlsx).

Concrete asks:
1) Can infra (@dev_patel) run a focused staging compatibility check against the Acme prompt set and the synthetic high-LR traffic profile (target: reproduce or rule out OOMs) by 2025-08-10? Please capture heap profiles and KV-cache stats.
2) Product (@laura_bennett) to confirm acceptable drift thresholds for the pilot and sign off on the evaluation prompt set by 2025-08-07.
3) Research/Model Ops (@aditya_rao) to propose a trimmed quantized variant (comet-13b-lite-quant-v1) and a short canary validation plan for accuracy/regression tests.

Proposal: pin v1.2.0 in hosted and dedicated fleets for the Acme account only (tenant pin) until validation completes or until 2026-01-01, whichever comes first. During the pin window, we should:
- Run a 1% traffic canary seeded with Acme test prompts (telemetry linked to the lifecycle matrix).
- Add an automatic fallback to the last-known-good variant if latency or error budget breaches are detected.

Sarah / Acme: looping you in so you’re aware of the temporary pin and the validation work. We’ll keep you updated and won’t make any changes to the model serving stack without your signoff during the pilot.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Lead Product Manager, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachments: comet13b_lifecycle_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lang <sarah@acmehealth.io>
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model intake: request to pin Comet-13b-lite (v1.2.0) and lifecycle matrix for Q4 pilot

Thanks Mina — I can take the infra validation. Quick notes from an infra perspective:
- I’ll run the Acme prompt set through our staging fleet (same infra flavor as the dedicated 8GB pods). I’ll capture mem profiles, GPU utilization, and KV cache hit/miss.
- If OOMs reproduce at seq_len=2048, we should test a modified batching policy and a reduced max_seq_len throat to see if we can keep the existing binary without pinning indefinitely.

Telemetry request: please confirm which telemetry keys to extract. I’ll collect: token latency p50/p95, allocator OOM traces, prefill time, and prompt-specific divergence rates. I attached a sample runtime profile from a synthetic run (runtime_profile_0825.log).

Canary suggestion: 72-hour canary at 1% traffic into the dedicated fleet with a 5-minute failure window (if error rate or latency >x2 baseline, auto-roll back). I’ll draft the canary config if you want.

Dev
Dev Patel
Software Engineer, Serving Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachments: runtime_profile_0825.log (log)

On Sun, Aug 3, 2025 at 09:12 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [original message]
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model intake: request to pin Comet-13b-lite (v1.2.0) and lifecycle matrix for Q4 pilot

Appreciate the notes. Product perspective:
- Drift threshold: for Acme’s clinical prompts we require <3% semantic-change rate (measured by our internal pass/fail eval harness using the gold prompt set). If drift exceeds that, we do not proceed with the pilot.
- Timeline: sign-off on prompt set by 2025-08-07. If infra validation reproduces OOMs, we will:
  a) Block external rollout until OOM root cause is addressed, or
  b) Proceed with tenant pin plus soft-limit on seq_len to 1024 for the Acme pilot, with explicit documentation to Acme about degraded long-context behavior.
- Pin duration: I’m comfortable with the temporary tenant pin through 2026-01-01 (same as Mina’s proposal) conditional on weekly regression checks.

Action items assigned:
- @aditya_rao: please produce the trimmed quantized variant proposal and an initial eval matrix (include latency, token-accuracy, and hallucination checks).
- @dev_patel: share canary config by EOD 2025-08-04 so we can review auto-rollback thresholds.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Principal Product Manager, Inference
Redwood Inference

Related doc: https://redwood-internal.drive/acme/pilot-intake-2025
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lang <sarah@acmehealth.io>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model intake: request to pin Comet-13b-lite (v1.2.0) and lifecycle matrix for Q4 pilot

Thanks all — summary and owners:
- Tenant pin: place a tenant-specific pin on Comet-13b-lite v1.2.0 for Acme Health immediately after infra confirms no blocking runtime issue (Dev).
- Infra (Dev): run the staging compatibility check and post results + telemetry (deadline: 2025-08-10). Share canary config by EOD 2025-08-04.
- Product (Laura): finalize drift thresholds and submit the approved Acme prompt set by 2025-08-07. Weekly regression checks during the pin window.
- Model Ops/Research (Aditya): propose trimmed quantized variant (comet-13b-lite-quant-v1) and an eval plan; target proposal: 2025-08-14.

Fallback & rollback: 72-hour canary at 1% traffic with auto-rollback on predefined SLO breaches. If we see hallucination upticks >2x baseline or >3% semantic-change rate, we rollback immediately.

I’ve uploaded the lifecycle matrix and canary plan to the linked drive folder and added the HubSpot deal link to the sheet. I’ll update Acme after infra validation — Sarah, you should expect a short note by 8/11.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Lead Product Manager, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachments: canary_plan_0725.md (doc), comet13b_lifecycle_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
